xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4399: Post-planning auto-spawn fails silently when the workspace Docker stack rebuild fails; issue sits with no work agent

plan.title: Post-planning auto-spawn fails silently when the workspace Docker stack rebuild fails; issue sits with no work agent
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: When planning finalizes with auto-start and the workspace docker stack is unhealthy, complete-planning posts /api/workspaces/:id/rebuild-and-start, treats its immediate 200 as 'work agent spawned', and the detached rebuild then fails with only one activity line. Nothing journals or retries it, and because the plan commit puts the feature branch ahead of main, deriveIssueState shows the agentless issue as 'working'. PAN-4370 and PAN-4384 sat 7-9 hours this way on 2026-09-29.
narratives.Proposal: Treat a stack-unhealthy auto-start refusal as a PAN-4155 deferred hand-off (reason 'stack-unhealthy') retried by deacon-lite, drop the fire-and-forget rebuild-and-start hop, journal handoff.started on accepted auto-starts, and derive a new 'work-not-started' attention plus a workStart detail from the workspace journal so Command Deck shows 'Work agent not started' / 'Work start retrying' instead of 'Working' and the Needs-you strip offers Start work with the error.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Spawning the work agent without the docker stack when plan items do not need it
- Fixing docker address-pool exhaustion
- Retrying failures that happen after an accepted spawn (container-wait timeout, background pan start failure); they are surfaced, not retried
- Changing the nine-state precedence or deriveState
- God View changes and cockpit NeedsYouSlot kinds
- Changing DEFERRED_HANDOFF_WINDOW_MS, the backoff, or SPAWN_STACK_REBUILD_* constants
- Removing the /api/workspaces/:id/rebuild-and-start route or the dashboard Rebuild & start action
- Showing Needs-you for planned issues that never had an auto-start (no handoff journal entry)
- Raising any scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt cap

autoDecisions.summary: Reuse the PAN-4155 deferred hand-off for stack-unhealthy refusals (reason 'stack-unhealthy') instead of a new retry loop
autoDecisions.rationale: The retry POSTs /api/agents whose stack gate already runs the bounded in-process rebuild (same rebuildWorkspaceStack as pan workspace rebuild); one schedule, journaled, restart-safe.

autoDecisions.summary: Remove the fire-and-forget rebuild-and-start hop from the auto-start path; keep the route and UI action
autoDecisions.rationale: Its 200 was reported as workAgentSpawned:true before anything ran (root cause of PAN-4384), and it would race deacon-lite's +2 min retry on the same compose project.

autoDecisions.summary: Surface late failures after an accepted spawn via a journaled handoff.started plus a 10-minute grace, not by retrying them
autoDecisions.rationale: The container-wait path returns success before the outcome; derivation catches any such path generically without adding retry state to spawn-helpers.

autoDecisions.summary: Add IssueAttention 'work-not-started' and an optional workStart detail instead of changing the nine-state precedence
autoDecisions.rationale: Additive contract change; consumers override the 'Working' presentation while lanes, action phases and state precedence stay untouched.

autoDecisions.summary: Trigger the derivation only when the workspace journal has a handoff.* entry
autoDecisions.rationale: Human-initiated planning never journals a hand-off and correctly waits for pan start (pickup gate); flagging every planned issue would flood Needs-you.

autoDecisions.summary: Scope surfaces to Command Deck and the Kanban/simple Needs-you strip; God View and the cockpit NeedsYouSlot are unchanged
autoDecisions.rationale: God View only draws agent-backed orbs so it never showed these issues as working; the strip already has a Start work button posting /api/agents; keeps the plan under the 25-file / 6-subsystem finalize limits.

autoDecisions.summary: The issue's 'spawn without waiting for the Docker stack' idea is a NonGoal
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue says 'consider'; work keeps its deliberate hard stack gate (PAN-1645) and per-plan stack need is a separate design.

autoDecisions.summary: Keep the 2-hour deferral window for stack failures
autoDecisions.rationale: Three bounded rebuilds land within ~40 minutes; later retries only detect an operator fix, and the 'Work start retrying' label keeps the issue visible meanwhile.

items.title: Carry the deferral reason (guardrails | stack-unhealthy) through deferred-handoff.ts

expected_outputs: deacon-lite-retry-deferred-handoff.test.ts passes including the new stack-unhealthy cases

narrative.Action: PRD WI-1 (.pan/drafts/PAN-4399.md). In src/lib/cloister/deferred-handoff.ts: export type DeferredHandoffReason = 'guardrails' | 'stack-unhealthy'; add option reason?: DeferredHandoffReason to recordHandoffDeferred and write `reason: options.reason ?? 'guardrails'` instead of the hardcoded `reason: 'guardrails'` (line ~77); add readReason(entry) reading entry.data.reason ('stack-unhealthy' else 'guardrails'); copy `reason` into every handoff.retried entry; at the window give-up (line ~217, `giveUpHandoff(workspacePath, issueId, schedule, 'guardrails', 'spawn guardrails still refused the work agent', emitActivity)`) pass the read reason and the message 'the workspace docker stack is still unhealthy' for stack-unhealthy, preferring the last retry's data.error when present. Update the module header comment. Tests use the file's existing injected-`now` pattern (no real timers).

items.title: Given a handoff.deferred entry with data.reason 'stack-unhealthy' and now past nextRetryAt, when retryDeferredHandoffs runs with a spawn stub answering { spawned: false, skippedReason: 'stack-unhealthy' }, then it appends handoff.retried whose data.reason is 'stack-unhealthy' and whose nextRetryAt is later
Given the same deferral and a spawn stub answering { spawned: true }, when retryDeferredHandoffs runs, then it appends handoff.started

Given the same deferral with now >= deferredAt + DEFERRED_HANDOFF_WINDOW_MS, when retryDeferredHandoffs runs, then it appends handoff.abandoned with outcome 'gave-up' and skipReason 'stack-unhealthy' and emits a warn activity whose message contains 'pan start'
Given recordHandoffDeferred is called without a reason, then the journal entry's data.reason defaults to 'guardrails' (existing guardrail tests keep passing unchanged)
Defer a stack-unhealthy auto-start instead of posting rebuild-and-start

expected_outputs: complete-planning.test.ts passes with the replaced stack-unhealthy test

In recordPlanningAutoHandoffDeferred pass reason ('stack-unhealthy' when result.workAgentSkipReason is 'stack-unhealthy', else 'guardrails') to recordHandoffDeferred and build console/activity text from a cause string ('the workspace docker stack is unhealthy' | 'spawn guardrails'), keeping the Deacon-frozen variant. In src/cli/commands/plan-finalize.ts (~line 403) print the deferral cause from the response's workAgentSkipReason instead of hardcoded 'spawn guardrails'. Add work-not-started attention and DerivedWorkStart to the derived-issue-state contract

narrative.Action: PRD WI-3. In packages/contracts/src/derived-issue-state.ts add "work-not-started" to the IssueAttention literals (doc comment: auto-start was attempted but no work agent came up) and to ISSUE_ATTENTIONS; add `export const DerivedWorkStart = Schema.Struct({ status: Schema.Literals(["retrying", "not-started"]), at: Schema.String, error: Schema.optional(Schema.String), nextRetryAt: Schema.optional(Schema.String) })` with its type, and `workStart: Schema.optional(DerivedWorkStart)` on DerivedIssueState. packages/contracts/dist is untracked; commit source only.

npm run typecheck exits 0
Derive workStart and work-not-started attention from the workspace journal

narrative.Action: PRD WI-4. Create src/lib/overdeck/work-start-state.ts exporting WORK_START_GRACE_MS = 10 * 60_000, WorkStartFacts { lastHandoff: {type, at, data?} | null; workAgentStartedAt: number | null }, readWorkStartFacts(issueId, projectPath) (workspace path = getWorkspaceForIssue(ID)?.path from src/lib/workspaces/resolver.ts, else join(projectPath,'workspaces','feature-'+lower); null when missing or lastPipelineEntry(path,'handoff.') is null; workAgentStartedAt from getAgentState('agent-'+lower)?.startedAt imported from src/lib/agents/agent-state-read.js; try/catch -> null) and pure deriveWorkStart(facts, now) with the PRD rules: agent startedAt >= entry at -> undefined; deferred/retried -> {status:'retrying', at, error, nextRetryAt}; abandoned with outcome 'gave-up' -> {status:'not-started', at, error}; started and now-at > grace -> {status:'not-started', at, error:'The work agent was accepted but never started' + (queued ? ' (container startup did not finish)' : '')}; else undefined. In derived-issue-state.ts: IssueStateFacts.workStart?; deriveIssueState sets derived.workStart when no PR, not merged, no live pane, and sets attention 'work-not-started' for status 'not-started' when no other attention; IssueStateLoaderDeps.readWorkStart?; both loadIssueStateFacts and loadIssueStatesForProject call it only for no-PR issues. derived-issue-state.ts stays <= 1000 lines. Do not change deriveState.

items.title: Given a journal whose last handoff entry is handoff.abandoned outcome 'gave-up' with error E and no started work agent, deriveWorkStart returns status 'not-started' with error E

Given a last entry handoff.started 11 minutes before now with data.queued true and no started agent, deriveWorkStart returns status 'not-started' whose error ends with '(container startup did not finish)'; at 5 minutes it returns undefined
Given a last entry handoff.deferred and an agent-<issue> startedAt later than the entry, deriveWorkStart returns undefined

Given facts with branch.aheadOfMain 1, no PR, no panes and a not-started workStart, deriveIssueState returns state 'working', attention 'work-not-started' and workStart.status 'not-started'; with a live pane it returns no workStart
Given a handoff.deferred last entry, deriveIssueState returns workStart.status 'retrying' and no attention
